text: dsh-visual-plugin 是面向 DSH Web 的视觉媒体插件，在会话输入区提供视频上传入口，并在右侧面板展示图片描述历史和插件视频。它复用 DSH 当前支持图像的模型处理原生图片与视频关键帧；视频会在本机校验、转码并提取场景关键帧。用户可播放处理后的视频、把选中视频放入聊天草稿、复制图片回答并调整处理参数。适合需要在 DSH Web 中整理图片回答或询问视频内容的用户。视频处理需安装 FFmpeg/FFprobe 与 PySceneDetect；插件不要求单独配置视觉模型或 API Key。

dsh-visual-plugin adds video upload and a media panel to DSH Web. It keeps native image answers for copying and locally prepares video keyframes for the current DSH model. Users can browse and play videos and tune limits. Video support needs FFmpeg/FFprobe and PySceneDetect.

dsh-visual-plugin 的功能「视频问答」：视频经本机校验、转码和场景关键帧提取后，可由 video_describe 工具交给 DSH 当前支持图像的模型回答；上传视频并选中后触发。
dsh-visual-plugin 的功能「图片描述历史」：会话完成后记录原生图片回答，在右侧面板按图片展示当前和较早描述，用户可展开历史或复制文本。
dsh-visual-plugin 的功能「视频库与播放」：右侧面板列出当前会话的视频，支持播放规范化视频，并可将所选视频信息放入聊天草稿。
dsh-visual-plugin 的功能「视频处理设置」：插件设置卡可调整上传上限、存储配额、时长、输出尺寸、帧率、CRF 和关键帧上限，并显示本机视频依赖状态。
dsh-visual-plugin 的功能「清理媒体缓存」：用户可通过设置卡发起缓存清理，删除插件保存的图片描述和视频媒体文件，不清除 DSH 对话消息或原生图片附件。
dsh-visual-plugin 的使用须知：视频功能依赖运行 DSH 的环境中可用的 FFmpeg/FFprobe 和 PySceneDetect；图片功能不需要这些工具，插件设置卡可查看依赖状态。

dsh-visual-plugin README · dsh-visual-plugin：

A local-first visual media plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
Validate, transcode, and extract video keyframes locally; understand images and videos with DSH's current vision model, view image history, and play videos in the right panel.

English · 简体中文

A plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

dsh-visual-plugin README · dsh-visual-plugin：Video preprocessing and plugin-owned media storage stay on the machine running DSH. Images and extracted keyframes are sent through DSH to your selected model; whether inference runs locally depends on your DSH model configuration.

dsh-visual-plugin README · Features：- **Native image understanding** — uploaded images stay on DSH's native attachment and model path; the plugin does not configure or call a separate vision model.
- **Copyable image history** — the right panel records the current DSH model's final answer beside each image thumbnail, with expandable history and one-click copy.
- **Plugin-owned video upload** — accepts MP4, M4V, MOV, AVI, MPG/MPEG, MKV, and WebM only when extension, signature, and FFprobe agree.
- **Scene-aware video analysis** — normalizes to H.264/yuv420p MP4, extracts keyframes with PySceneDetect, and sends ordered timestamped images to the current DSH vision model.
- **Right-side panel** — switch between image/video views, play normalized videos directly, and stage a selected video in the chat draft.
- **Advanced video settings** — tune upload size, storage quota, duration, output size, FPS, CRF, and keyframe count from the plugin settings card.

dsh-visual-plugin README · How it works：

``` image → DSH native attachment → current image-capable model → final answer → /vision-bridge/recent → panel thumbnail + copyable description video → container validation → H.264/yuv420p normalization → PySceneDetect

dsh-visual-plugin README · How it works：The plugin never rewrites model messages or calls a private vision endpoint. Select an image-capable model in DSH before sending images or asking about a video.
dsh-visual-plugin README · Quick start：Plugin `0.4.x` targets DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`; keep plugin `0.3.2` for DSH `0.1.x`. No exact-version risk exemption is needed.

dsh-visual-plugin README · 1. Install host dependencies：Image features work without these tools. Video support requires FFmpeg/FFprobe `>= 6.1` from the same major release, an FFmpeg build with `libx264`, and PySceneDetect `>= 0.7.1 < 0.8`.

Install the tools on the machine and under the user account that runs `dsh web`. The commands `ffmpeg`, `ffprobe`, and `scenedetect` must be available on that process's `PATH`, from any directory. If DSH runs in Docker, WSL, or on a remote server, install the dependencies inside that environment.

dsh-visual-plugin README · macOS (Homebrew)：Install [Homebrew](https://brew.sh/) first if needed, and follow its post-install instructions to add `brew` to your `PATH`. Then install [FFmpeg](https://formulae.brew.sh/formula/ffmpeg), which includes FFprobe, and [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/):

```sh
brew install ffmpeg uv
```

dsh-visual-plugin README · Arch Linux (pacman)：Install the official [FFmpeg](https://archlinux.org/packages/extra/x86_64/ffmpeg/) and [uv](https://archlinux.org/packages/extra/x86_64/uv/) packages:

```sh
sudo pacman -Syu ffmpeg uv
```

dsh-visual-plugin README · Windows (PowerShell, WinGet)：Open PowerShell and confirm [WinGet](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/package-manager/winget/) is available with `winget --version`. If it is missing, install or update **App Installer** using the instructions in that link. On Windows x64, install FFmpeg (including FFprobe) and uv:

```powershell
winget install --id Gyan.FFmpeg --exact
winget install --id astral-sh.uv --exact
```

dsh-visual-plugin README · Windows (PowerShell, WinGet)：Close and reopen PowerShell before continuing so the new `PATH` takes effect. If WinGet is unavailable, use a Windows build linked from the [FFmpeg download page](https://ffmpeg.org/download.html), extract it to a permanent directory such as `C:\Tools\ffmpeg`, and add the directory containing `ffmpeg.exe` and `ffprobe.exe` (usually `bin`) to your user `Path` in **Environment Variables**. Install uv using its [official Windows instructions](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/).

dsh-visual-plugin README · Install PySceneDetect with uv (all three systems)：Run the following in your terminal or PowerShell:

```sh
uv tool install --python 3.12 "scenedetect>=0.7.1,<0.8"
uv tool update-shell
```

text: dsh-visual-plugin README · Install PySceneDetect with uv (all three systems)：This installs PySceneDetect as a persistent command in an isolated environment for the current user. uv downloads Python 3.12 if needed; the standard `scenedetect` package includes its OpenCV dependencies. You do not need to activate a virtual environment before starting DSH. See the [uv tool guide](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/tools/) and [PySceneDetect installation guide](https://www.scenedetect.com/download/).

dsh-visual-plugin README · 2. Verify dependencies：Close and reopen your terminal after `uv tool update-shell`. In the same environment you will use to start DSH, run:

```sh
ffmpeg -version
ffprobe -version
ffmpeg -hide_banner -encoders
scenedetect version

Confirm FFmpeg and FFprobe are both `>= 6.1` and have the same major version, the encoder list includes `libx264`, and PySceneDetect is `>= 0.7.1 < 0.8`.

dsh-visual-plugin README · 2. Verify dependencies：If a command is missing, locate it with `command -v ffmpeg ffprobe scenedetect` on macOS/Arch, or `Get-Command ffmpeg, ffprobe, scenedetect` in PowerShell. For PySceneDetect, `uv tool dir --bin` shows the directory that must be on `PATH`. Services and containers must also receive this `PATH`; restart the DSH process after changing it.

The plugin never downloads these tools or runs installers. The settings card reports video dependency issues while image features remain available.

dsh-visual-plugin README · 3. Install the plugin：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-visual-plugin   # or: github:jyh20030112/dsh-visual-plugin
```

When developing this checkout against a local DeepSeek Harness source tree, install the local package instead:

```sh
cd /absolute/path/to/dsh-visual-plugin
npm run bootstrap
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-visual-plugin
```

dsh-visual-plugin README · 3. Install the plugin：`bootstrap` requires an installed, built `dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2` Harness checkout and automatically finds a sibling or ancestor-adjacent checkout.
For another layout, set its location explicitly:

```sh
HARNESS=/absolute/path/to/deepseek-harness npm run bootstrap
```

dsh-visual-plugin README · 4. Restart and use：Restart `dsh web` from the environment where the dependency checks passed, then:

1. Open **Settings → Plugins**, then the **dsh-visual-plugin** detail page and its **Visual Media** configuration. Use **Sidebar** to show or hide the right panel and adjust advanced video settings. Changes apply immediately, persist in the current profile across restarts, and recover valid archived video preferences without overwriting new settings during upgrades.
dsh-visual-plugin README · 4. Restart and use：

dsh-visual-plugin README · 4. Restart and use：2. Select an image-capable model in DSH; there is no separate vision-model configuration in this plugin.
3. Send an image. The current model answers natively, and the image panel records the thumbnail and final answer for copying.
4. Upload a video from **Upload video** beside the composer. Once processing finishes, select **Videos** in the right panel to play it; **Ask in chat** stages a draft and never submits automatically.

dsh-visual-plugin README · Vision model：Image and keyframe understanding use the image-capable model currently selected in DSH. Model providers, endpoints, and credentials are managed by DSH rather than this plugin.

dsh-visual-plugin README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-visual-plugin
```

Restart `dsh web`. The command forwards to `pnpm remove` inside the profile, and the bundle layer list reconciles to drop the plugin automatically.
